observations: AgriSURE is a Category-II AIF promoted by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare and NABARD, with NABVENTURES Limited as Investment Manager.

The official page separates a INR 450 crore Fund-of-Funds route for eligible AIFs from a INR 300 crore Direct Scheme for early-stage agriculture and rural startups; the total INR 750 crore is fund-level capital.

Target sectors include agritech, food processing, animal husbandry, fisheries, supply chain, farm mechanisation, biotechnology, waste management, renewable energy, agri-value chain, FPO support, farm-level technology and climate change.

Startups or AIFs may reach out to the Investment Manager at agrisure@nabard.org. The official page states that qualifying criteria do not guarantee sanction or investment, and the NABARD public notice warns against intermediaries charging money.
The public sources do not establish an individual startup ticket, valuation, dilution, governance, exit terms or fixed deadline. Direct and FoF routes remain separate and the record stays in review.
reviewFollowUps: Verify the current NABVENTURES intake, fund availability, applicable Private Placement Memorandum and route-specific application/diligence documents.
Confirm Direct Scheme startup definitions, stage, sectors, instruments, investment committee process, ticket size, valuation, dilution and exit terms.
Confirm FoF AIF incorporation, SEBI Category I/II status, corpus limit, 5%/INR 25 crore cap, investment mandate and onward-investment conditions.
Confirm the NABVENTURES/NABARD authority mapping against the official IGOD/Ministry of Agriculture organizational source before publication.
